issues.description: README links ASR config at conf/train/... but file lives at conf/...
issues.detail: README references ./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml; the actual path is ./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml. The link 404s and the README misdocuments the very artifact it points at. Fix the link to match the real path.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh warns about missing unzip but does not exit, conflating warning with failure
issues.detail: When unzip is absent the script echoes a message and proceeds, later invoking unzip and dying with a cryptic error. Under set -euo pipefail a half-check is worse than no check. Exit non-zero on the missing precondition so downstream stages do not run on empty data.

issues.description: Duplicate db.sh added as both a real file and a TEMPLATE symlink at the same path
issues.detail: The diff introduces egs2/tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1/db.sh as a regular file with TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH=downloads and also as a symlink to ../../TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh. Only one can occupy the path. Recipes use the TEMPLATE symlink and edit the global db.sh; drop the standalone file.

issues.description: Usage block prints help but does not exit on bad argc
issues.detail: The argc guard cats the usage then falls through with $1 potentially unset. Under set -u, realpath of an unset positional aborts with an opaque unbound-variable error instead of a clean usage failure. Add an explicit exit 1 after printing usage.

issues.description: Hard-coded utterance counts and opaque sed normalization complect dataset facts with control flow
issues.detail: data.sh aborts on magic counts (22467/3208/6072/29386/38924) and inlines a full-width-character sed chain with no comment on the normalization target. Any benign upstream dataset change breaks the recipe; the normalization set cannot be audited. Extract counts and rules into named, documented data tables.

issues.description: run.sh sets lm_train_text and lm_config while use_lm defaults to false, contradicting README LM results
issues.detail: use_lm=false yet --lm_config and --lm_train_text are still passed, while the README reports an LM-decoded results row. Either default use_lm=true to match the documented numbers, or drop the LM arguments when LM is disabled. As written the script's intent is ambiguous.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a standard ESPnet bootcamp recipe addition where most code is template boilerplate, but the new data-prep shell scripts are sloppy under set -euo pipefail. Two issues have full consensus: the README's ASR config link points at a non-existent conf/train/ path, and download_and_untar.sh warns about missing unzip without exiting. Additional concerns include a duplicate db.sh (file plus symlink at the same path), a usage block that falls through without exit, and hard-coded utterance counts plus an opaque full-width character normalization that intertwine dataset facts with control flow. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK; fixes are small and obvious.
